title: Fanta's AI slop Halloween advert is a real horror show
key_facts: Fanta has released a Halloween advert made by the AI studio GRAiL for its 'Haunted Universe', which it wants to become an annual Halloween occasion.
The universe has AI-made characters such as a cyborg Frankenstein and a werewolf DJ, and Ghostface from Scream makes a guest appearance.
The writer saw the ad before a film at a cinema; their X post about it is dated 1 Oct 2026.
Almost all comments on the video are negative, and many people vow never to buy Fanta again.
Fanta is the headline sponsor of Thorpe Park Fright Nights, which the writer says has also been marred by AI content.
The article says the Coca-Cola Company is still making AI ads, after its AI Christmas adverts drew similar criticism.
quote_evidence: Almost all of the comments are negative, and there are many from people vowing to never buy Fanta again.
The idea is to make this an annual occasion, with the universe and story to develop in future years.
Many people strongly oppose the use of AI imagery on ethical grounds.
why_it_matters_hint: A big drinks brand keeps using AI ads despite strong public objections.
